slices.description: Every eligible 2025 player-season, all positions and scoring presets
slices.rationale: The production-realistic result. 2025's universe is what a 2026 draft board actually has to rank, zero-production players included, so this is the primary final-holdout metric and nothing may substitute for it.

slices.description: 2025 rows whose eligibility is supported by the prior-season roster or the target-season draft class, i.e. discoverable under the pre-snapshot mechanism
slices.rationale: 2025 is the first season whose universe can also be established by a pre-anchor depth snapshot (ADR-022). Restricting to the earlier-era mechanisms separates 'the model degraded' from 'the universe widened'. Diagnostic only.

slices.description: Rows flagged as rookies by prior-existence evidence
slices.rationale: Rookies are the lowest-information population; their error is expected to be larger and must not be averaged away.
The complement of the rookie slice, reported alongside it so the split is exhaustive.

slices.description: Grouped by ADR-018 depth context: observed, prior-season role, none
slices.rationale: 2025 is the only season where all three depth states occur. The Phase-3 core feature set excludes the snapshot-only depth columns, so this slice measures whether their absence costs anything on the rows that have them.
A positional collapse is invisible in a pooled number; the promotion gate is defined per position for the same reason.
Each preset is a separate model; each gets a separate result.

slices.description: Rows with a substantial prior-season workload: prior stats exist and the player appeared in at least eight games of the previous season
slices.rationale: 'Information-rich' is defined from feature availability alone, fixed here before any outcome is seen. Eight games is half a season under either horizon.
Reported with its complement so the split is exhaustive and neither half can be quietly dropped.

B0.point_rule: veterans: prior-season points per game in the row's scoring flavour, optionally shrunk towards the position's typical rate, times the training-fold mean games played by players in the same previous-season availability and age cohort; players without usable prior production: the training-fold mean season total for their draft-capital bucket
B0.quantiles: training-fold residuals from an inner chronological split
B0.shrinkage_selection: lowest MAE on an inner chronological split of the training window; the validation season is never consulted

calibration.rationale: L2 projection onto a closed convex cone containing the true quantile vector, so the repair provably cannot move the estimate away from it
steps: isotonic (PAV) projection onto the monotone cone

components.availability: LightGBM quantile regression on games / horizon weeks
components.performance: LightGBM quantile regression on fantasy points per active game, fitted on training rows with at least one game

composition.dependence: Gaussian copula with one fold-fitted correlation, estimated from probability-integral transforms on an inner chronological split
composition.negative_totals: permitted; this project's scoring presets allow them
composition.rule: round(rate x horizon weeks) games x points per game; zero games scores zero

CB.family: availability x conditional performance hurdle, Monte Carlo composed
CB.grain: position x scoring preset x quantile
CB.tuning: none; Q1's predeclared LightGBM configuration is reused unchanged
